title: Read ingress: authenticated principal, service admission and per-page fencing
summary: A locally authoritative server must resolve the XTP-delivered service and authenticated caller, check a distinct ACL provider, limit incoming windows, and revalidate owner incarnation before every page. XTP FIRST/KEY/ACK and service names do not convey memory permissions.
invariants: The service name accepted from native XTP ingress must resolve to the registered local route peer and normal.memory class; a caller-supplied class or peer name has no admission authority.
Transport evidence is resolved by an injected real authenticator to a nonempty principal, not by treating the incoming string as a credential. ACL decisions are local and exact-true only.
The current block generation, owning provider ID, owner epoch, server-side block length and requested aligned bytes must be verified against MemoryFabricRegistry~resolveBlock before admission.

The permit checks identity, service, authorization, expiry and current provider generation/epoch for EACH page and again before publishing bytes; read permits do not authorize writes or ownership transfers.

An in-process duplicate-request guard is bounded to 4096 entries and expires entries; it does not provide durable replay resistance across service restarts. It cannot be used for non-idempotent mutations.

Source-side operational-capacity tickets, native ingress wiring, real cryptographic authentication, complete page payload integrity, receiver merge and XTP group multicast remain unqualified; do not present this gate as a complete remote-memory transfer.
procedure: Bind XTP named listener service to local ServiceRegistry.
Resolve transport proof through the authenticated-identity adapter and confirm ACL to the current block/window.
Reject noncurrent providers, blocked/revoked principals, nonaligned/out-of-window pages and expired requests.
Validate permit immediately before each bounded page read and before any publish.
Hold per-context capacity admission and remote integrity/commit out of scope until proven.

provenance.claim: Source implements fail-closed service/identity/ACL admission, 60s TTL, <=16MiB window, 4096 request IDs and page-level epoch/ACL recheck. Source-file hash, not package-archive hash.
Registry resolveBlock and provider reincarnation are authoritative for current block and owner epoch.
